verdict.rationale: Typesense is a search engine with a hosted SaaS offering (Typesense Cloud), so a data-use or AI-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, no data-use policy and no no-training commitment. Self-hosting and SOC 2 compliance are adjacent controls, not a documented guarantee that customer data is not used for model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
